# FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) — Complete LLM Context & Technical Reference



> **FrameAssembly** (`frameassembly` v1.4.5) is an offline, rootless "Packets as Code" Domain-Specific Language (`.fasm`, media type `text/vnd.frameassembly`) and six-stage Rust 2024 compiler that synthesizes deterministic, nanosecond-resolution `.pcap` and `.pcapng` packet captures across **81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7 network protocols**—with automatic 4-tuple TCP `SEQ`/`ACK` progression, bidirectional reply-port swapping, IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack flow reuse, IEEE 1815 DNP3 / RFC 9260 SCTP / RFC 1071 checksums, and full SNMPv3 USM (`RFC 3414` / `3826` / `7860`) cryptography.



* **Canonical Repository:** `https://github.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly`

* **Rust Crate & Docs:** `https://crates.io/crates/frameassembly` | `https://docs.rs/frameassembly`

* **WebAssembly & IDE:** `https://www.npmjs.com/package/frameassembly-wasm` | `SteveWinschel.frameassembly-vscode`

* **Upstream Companion Role:** FrameAssembly compiles human-readable, `git diff`-friendly `.fasm` specifications in unprivileged user space (zero `CAP_NET_RAW`, zero live sockets, zero `libpcap`) into standard `.pcap` / `.pcapng` files consumed downstream by **Wireshark**, **`tshark`**, **`tcpreplay`**, **Suricata**, **Zeek**, and **Snort**.

## 1. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Language Contract, Execution Semantics & Format Disambiguation



### 1.1 Three-Block Program Model & Lexical Rules



Every compilable `.fasm` file (`UTF-8` without BOM, `LF` or `CRLF` line endings, zero literal `0x00` NUL bytes) consists of three top-level constructs:



1. **Endpoint Declarations (`host`)**:

   ```frameassembly

   host client_v4 {

       ip 10.10.1.10

       mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:10

   }

   host server_v4 {

       ip 10.10.1.80

   }

   flow ping_check(c, s) {

       c -> s icmp echo_request id 1 seq 1

       c <- s icmp echo_reply id 1 seq 1 wait 2ms

   }

   compile {

       ping_check(client_v4, server_v4)

   }

   ```

   * **`ip <ipv4_or_ipv6>` (Required)**: Uses the single keyword `ip` for **both** IPv4 (`10.0.0.1`) and IPv6 (`2001:db8::1`, `fe80::1`, `ff02::fb`). Never write `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `addr`, or CIDR masks (`/24`) inside `host`.

   * **`mac <mac_addr>` (Optional)**: Accepts IEEE colon (`00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e`), hyphen (`00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5E`), and Cisco dotted-quad (`001a.2b3c.4d5e`) notations natively.

2. **Parameterized Traffic Flows (`flow`)**:

   * Signature: `flow <name>(<param1>, <param2>, ...) { <frame_statements> }`. Parameter parentheses are mandatory even for zero-argument flows, though practical flows declare 2 to 8+ endpoint parameters.

   * **1 Statement = 1 Wire Frame**: Every `<ep_a> -> <ep_b> ...` or `<ep_a> <- <ep_b> ...` statement emits **one** Ethernet frame, even if wrapped across multiple indented lines. Statements terminate automatically when the next `<caller> ->|<-` or closing `}` is encountered (never use `;`).

   * **Directional Operators**: `a -> b` sends from `a` (source) to `b` (destination). `a <- b` sends from `b` (source) back to `a` (destination), preserving visual alignment with Wireshark Flow Graphs while automatically reversing IPs, MACs, and transport ports.

3. **Compilation & Loop Schedule (`compile`)**:

   * Every `.fasm` file must contain **exactly one** `compile { ... }` block (duplicate or missing `compile` blocks fail parsing).

   * Inside `compile`, invoke flows (`my_flow(host1, host2)`) or repeat invocations inside `loop <u32_count> { my_flow(host1, host2) }`.

4. **ASCII Case-Insensitivity & BPE Token Convention**:

   * All 640+ lexer keywords, all 81 protocol names, all modifiers, time unit suffixes (`ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, `m`), and user-defined identifiers (`host`, `flow`, parameters) are ASCII case-insensitive (`host` == `HOST` == `Host`).

   * **Contextual Identifiers**: Because `parse_spanned_ident` recovers all keyword tokens as valid identifiers, users can safely name hosts or flows `dns`, `http`, `client`, `get`, or `ms`.

   * **Recommended Emission Casing**: Prefer **lowercase** keywords (`host`, `flow`, `tcp syn`, `dstport 443`) for optimal BPE subword efficiency unless the user prompt explicitly requests `UPPERCASE`. Double-quoted string literals (`"..."`) always preserve exact wire casing.



### 1.2 Deterministic Backend State Machines & Wire Constants



When generating `.fasm` or writing assertions against `compile_program` / `tshark`, rely on these exact constants from `src/backend/mod.rs`, `src/packet.rs`, and `src/pcap.rs`:



| Subsystem | Deterministic Compiler Constant / Rule |

| :--- | :--- |

| **PCAPNG Container** | `LINKTYPE_ETHERNET` (`1`), `snaplen = 65535`, `IfTsResol(9)` ($10^{-9}\text{ s}$ nanosecond resolution). |

| **Base Epoch & `wait`** | Base clock starts at `1_700_000_000_000_000_000` ns (`2023-11-14T22:13:20Z`). Each statement adds `stmt.wait.unwrap_or(10_000_000)` (`10ms` default) **before** emitting its frame. `frameassembly show` subtracts frame 1's timestamp so frame 1 displays at `0.000` ms and frame 2 displays at frame 2's `wait` delta. |

| **Default Protocol Fallback** | If a statement omits an explicit protocol keyword: `vlan` modifier $\rightarrow$ `VLAN`; else `qinq` $\rightarrow$ `QINQ`; else `mpls` $\rightarrow$ `MPLS`; else `transport udp` $\rightarrow$ `UDP`; else **`TCP`**. |

| **Port Inheritance (`->`/`<-`)** | Remembered per `(caller, callee)` pair (`EndpointPairPorts`). Forward `->`: `srcport` defaults to remembered `caller_port` or `12345`; `dstport` defaults to protocol well-known port (or explicit `callee_port`). Reverse `<-`: swaps `srcport` and `dstport` automatically. |

| **4-Tuple TCP State Machine** | Keyed by canonical sorted socket pair `((IpAddr, u16), (IpAddr, u16))`. Initializes `seq1 = 1000`, `seq2 = 1000`. `syn` advances sender `seq` by `+1`; `fin` advances sender `seq` by `+1`; payload advances sender `seq` by `payload.len() as u32` (wrapping 32-bit math). Sets `acknum` to peer's current `seq` whenever `ack` or a TCP L7 protocol is active. |

| **Default TCP Flags & Window**| Raw `tcp` without flags or payload $\rightarrow$ `SYN` (`0x02`). Raw `tcp` with payload or any TCP-based L7 protocol without explicit flags $\rightarrow$ `PSH ACK` (`0x18`). Default `win` = `64240` (`0xFAF0`). |

| **Default `TTL` / Hop Limit** | `64` across IPv4 and IPv6, except **`255`** automatically on `ndp`, `vrrp`, and IPv6 `arp` when `ttl` is omitted. |

| **MAC Derivation Priority** | 1. Statement `srcmac` / `dstmac` $\rightarrow$ 2. Protocol L2 group MAC (`lldp`, `stp`, `lacp`, `eapol`, broadcast `arp request`) $\rightarrow$ 3. Multicast target IP (`224.0.0.0/4` $\rightarrow$ `01:00:5e:xx:xx:xx`; `ff00::/8` $\rightarrow$ `33:33:xx:xx:xx:xx`) $\rightarrow$ 4. `host` `mac` $\rightarrow$ 5. Unicast fallback (`00:00:00:00:00:01` caller, `00:00:00:00:00:02` callee). |

| **Semantic Bounds Gate** | `vlan`: `1..=4094`; `dscp`: `0..=63`; `ecn`: `0..=3`; `ttl`: `0..=255`; `flowlabel`: `0..=1048575` (`0xFFFFF`); `gentrap`: `0..=6`. Mixing IPv4 and IPv6 endpoints in one statement is rejected. |



### 1.3 Authoritative Three-Way `.fasm` Extension Disambiguation



| Dimension | **FrameAssembly (`.fasm`)** | **x86 Flat Assembler (`.asm`, `.fasm`)** | **FPGA Bitstream Assembly (`.fasm`)** |

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Domain** | Declarative network packet capture compiler ("Packets as Code") | x86 / x86-64 CPU machine-code assembler | SymbiFlow / F4PGA hardware tile bitstream config |

| **Media Type** | `text/vnd.frameassembly` (`io.github.stevewinschel.frameassembly`) | Unregistered (`text/x-asm`) | Unregistered (`text/plain`) |

| **Comments** | `// single-line comment` (`;` and `#` are lex errors) | `; single-line comment` | `# single-line comment` |

| **Syntax Anchors** | `host { ip ... }`, `flow(...) { a -> b ... }`, `compile { ... }` | `format PE`/`ELF`, `section`, `use64`, `mov eax, 1` | `CLBLL_L_X10Y100.SLICEL_X0.ALUT.INIT[63:0]` |

| **Output Artifact**| `.pcap` / `.pcapng` network capture | `.bin`, `.obj`, `.o`, `.exe`, `.elf` machine code | `.frames` / `.bit` FPGA bitstream |



*(Note: `frameassembly::error::detect_foreign_fasm` automatically detects x86 Flat Assembler and FPGA FASM inputs and emits a plain-English remediation hint.)*



---



## 2. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Anti-Hallucination Table & Cross-Protocol Syntax Guardrails



| Category | Invalid / Hallucinated Syntax (NEVER WRITE) | Canonical `.fasm` Syntax (ALWAYS WRITE) |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Comments** | `# router config` or `/* block */` or `; note` | `// router config` |

| **String Quotes** | `'single-quoted string'` | `"double-quoted string"` |

| **Key-Value Punctuation**| `ip = 10.0.0.1`, `dstport: 443`, `ttl=64;` | `ip 10.0.0.1`, `dstport 443`, `ttl 64` (whitespace-delimited) |

| **Host IP & CIDR** | `host r1 { ipv4 10.0.0.1/24 }` or `host r2 { ipv6 ::1 }` | `host r1 { ip 10.0.0.1 }` and `host r2 { ip ::1 }` |

| **Flow Declaration** | `flow test { a -> b icmp }` (missing parameter list) | `flow test(a, b) { a -> b icmp }` |

| **Orphan Statements** | Top-level `client -> server icmp` outside `flow` | Wrap inside `flow f(c, s) { c -> s icmp }` + `compile { f(client, server) }` |

| **Timing Delays** | Standalone `wait 5ms` line or `+5ms a -> b tcp syn` | `a -> b tcp syn wait 5ms` (`ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, `m`) |

| **L4 Port Names** | `sport 50000 dport 443` or `src_port` / `dst_port` | `srcport 50000 dstport 443` |

| **TCP Ack Flag vs Num**| `tcp ack 1001` (number immediately after `ack`) | `tcp ack acknum 1001` (`ack` is flag; `acknum <u32>` is number) |

| **TCP Flags List** | `tcp [syn, ack]` or `flags "SA"` | `tcp syn ack` |

| **802.1Q / 802.1ad** | `vlan_id 100 cos 5` or `qinq 2000 100` | `vlan 100 pcp 5` or `qinq 2000 inner_vlan 100` |

| **HTTP / SSDP Host** | `http get uri "/" host "example.com"` | `http get uri "/" host_hdr "example.com"` (`host` is top-level reserved) |

| **RTSP Transport Hdr** | `rtsp setup transport "RTP/AVP;unicast"` | `rtsp setup transport_hdr "RTP/AVP;unicast"` (`transport` selects L4 `tcp`\|`udp`) |

| **BGP vs RIP Prefix** | `bgp update prefix 10.1.0.0/16` / `rip prefix "10.1.0.0/24"` | `bgp update prefix "10.1.0.0/16"` (quoted CIDR) / `rip prefix 10.1.0.0` (bare IP) |

| **DHCP vs DNS TxID** | `dhcp discover txid 0x1234` | `dhcp discover xid 0x1234` (`dhcp`, `openflow`, `nfs` use `xid`) |

| **IKEv2 Exchanges** | `ikev2 exchange auth` | `ikev2 sa_init`, `ikev2 create_child_sa`, or `ikev2 informational` |

| **SNMPv3 USM Syntax** | `snmp3 auth "sha256" "pass"` or `snmp3 priv aes "pass"` (no auth) | `snmp3 auth sha256 "pass" priv aes "pass"` (unquoted algos; `priv` requires `auth`) |

| **Payload Exclusivity**| `udp payload "abc" hexpayload "616263"` on same line | Specify **either** `payload "..."` **or** `hexpayload "..."`, never both |



---



## 3. FrameAssembly CLI, Companion Workflows & Public Rust Library API (`v1.4.5`)



### 3.1 CLI Usage & Upstream Companion Pipeline



```bash

frameassembly show capture.fasm

frameassembly capture.fasm -o capture.pcap

tshark -r capture.pcap -V

sudo tcpreplay -i eth0 capture.pcap

suricata -r capture.pcap -k none

zeek -C -r capture.pcap

```



### 3.2 Six-Stage Zero-Copy Rust Compiler Pipeline



1. **Stage 1 — Zero-Copy Lexing (`src/lexer/mod.rs`)**: `logos 0.14` jump-table DFA scanning `&'a str` into `(Token<'a>, Range<usize>)` slices with explicit regex priorities (`6`: multi-format MACs $\rightarrow$ `5`: IPv4 $\rightarrow$ `4`: decimal/hex numbers $\rightarrow$ `3`: ASN.1 OIDs $\rightarrow$ `2`: IPv6 & time units $\rightarrow$ `1`: identifiers).

2. **Stage 2 — Protocol-Scoped Combinator Parsing (`src/parser/`)**: `winnow 1.0` parser over `Stream<'i, 'a> = &'i [(Token<'a>, Range<usize>, &'a str)]`. `parse_frame_statement` runs `parse_universal_field` $\rightarrow$ `dispatch_protocol_field` (scoped to the active protocol so shared sub-keywords like `cookie`, `data`, `value`, `status`, `token`, `msgid`, `group`, `ack`, `rst` never shadow across protocols) $\rightarrow$ `parse_fallback_field`.

3. **Stage 3 — Semantic Validation (`src/parser/validation.rs`)**: `validate_semantics` enforces case-insensitive symbol uniqueness, flow arity, IPv4/IPv6 endpoint homogeneity, numeric field bounds, and cross-protocol modifier exclusivity.

4. **Stage 4 — Inner-Outward Wire Builders, Checksums & Crypto (`src/builders/`, `src/packet.rs`)**: Encapsulates `L7 -> L4 -> L3 -> MPLS/QinQ/VLAN/Ethernet II` with disjoint-slice RFC 1071 checksums (`internet_checksum`), RFC 8200 UDP `0x0000 -> 0xFFFF` folding, little-endian Castagnoli `CRC32c` for SCTP, little-endian IEEE 1815 `CRC-16` for DNP3, `rasn` ASN.1 BER/DER encoding, and SNMPv3 USM key localization ($K_u \rightarrow K_{ul}$), `DES-CBC` / `AES-128-CFB` encryption, and truncated HMAC signing.

5. **Stage 5 — Stateful 4-Tuple & Dynamic Dispatch Engine (`src/backend/`)**: Unrolls `compile` and `loop` blocks, tracks `EndpointPairPorts` and `Canonical4Tuple` TCP sequence state, preserves dynamic `L7DispatchResult` ports/multicast IPs (`dhcp`, `mdns`, `ptp`, `radius`), and derives multicast/unicast MACs.

6. **Stage 6 — Transactional Nanosecond PCAPNG Emission (`src/pcap.rs`)**: Synthesizes all frames in memory before opening disk files, writing `SHB -> IDB (ETHERNET, snaplen 65535, IfTsResol(9)) -> EPBs`.



### 3.3 Verified Public Rust Library Signatures & RLVR Reward Integration



```rust

use frameassembly::backend::{compile_program, generate_pcap};

use frameassembly::error::CompilerError;

use frameassembly::lexer::lex;

use frameassembly::parser::{parse_program, validate_semantics};



fn synthesize_and_verify() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {

    let fasm = r#"

        host hmi { ip 192.168.10.5  mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e }

        host plc { ip 192.168.10.20 mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5f }

        flow modbus_poll(c, s) {

            c -> s modbus txid 1 unitid 1 read_holding_registers addr 100 count 2 wait 5ms

            c <- s modbus txid 1 unitid 1 read_holding_registers count 2 value 42 is_response wait 5ms

        }

        compile { modbus_poll(hmi, plc) }

    "#;



    // 1. Lex + Parse + Validate Semantics automatically:

    let program = parse_program(fasm)?;

    // 2. Synthesize raw Ethernet frames + nanosecond timestamps in memory:

    let frames: Vec<(Vec<u8>, u64)> = compile_program(&program)?;

    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 2);

    assert_eq!(frames[1].1 - frames[0].1, 5_000_000); // 5ms = 5,000,000 ns



    // 3. Or write directly to a nanosecond PCAPNG file:

    generate_pcap(&program, "modbus.pcap")?;

    Ok(())

}



/// Dense 4-stage verifiable compiler reward R(x, y) in [0.0, 1.0] for RLVR / GRPO post-training.

pub fn compute_rlvr_reward(candidate_fasm: &str) -> f64 {

    if lex(candidate_fasm).is_err() {

        return 0.0;

    }

    match parse_program(candidate_fasm) {

        Ok(program) => match compile_program(&program) {

            Ok(frames) if !frames.is_empty() && frames.iter().all(|(b, _)| b.len() >= 14) => 1.0,

            _ => 0.60, // Passed lex (0.10) + syntax (0.20) + semantics (0.30)

        },

        Err(CompilerError::SemanticError { .. }) => 0.30, // Passed lex + syntax, failed semantics

        Err(_) => 0.10,                                   // Passed lex only

    }

}

```



**`frameassembly::error::CompilerError` Variants (`src/error.rs`, implements `miette::Diagnostic`)**:

* `CompilerError::LexError { src: String, span: (usize, usize) }` — code `"frameassembly::lex_error"`

* `CompilerError::ParseError { message: String, src: String, span: (usize, usize) }` — code `"frameassembly::parse_error"`

* `CompilerError::SemanticError { message: String, src: String, span: (usize, usize) }` — code `"frameassembly::semantic_error"`

* `CompilerError::BackendError(String)` — code `"frameassembly::backend_error"`



---



## 4. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Universal Layer 2, Layer 3, Layer 4, Payload & Timing Modifiers



Any packet statement in a `flow` accepts cross-layer modifiers in any order alongside its protocol fields:



| Layer | Modifier Syntax | Valid Bounds / Format | Wire Behavior & Default |

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **L2 Ethernet** | `srcmac <mac>` / `dstmac <mac>` | Colon, hyphen, or Cisco dotted | Overrides 48-bit outer Ethernet source or destination MAC |

| **L2 EtherType** | `ethertype <u16>` | `0..65535` (e.g., `0x88b5`) | Overrides outer 16-bit Ethernet II EtherType |

| **L2 802.1Q** | `vlan <1..4094> [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0..1>]` | VID `1..4094` (`0`/`4095` invalid) | Inserts 4-byte `0x8100` VLAN tag (`pcp 0`, `dei 0` defaults) |

| **L2 802.1ad** | `qinq <1..4094> [inner_vlan <1..4094>]` | VID `1..4094` | Inserts outer `0x88A8` S-Tag + inner `0x8100` C-Tag (uses `pcp`/`dei` on outer S-Tag) |

| **L2.5 MPLS** | `mpls <0..1048575> [exp\|tc <0..7>] [bos <0\|1>] [mpls_ttl <u8>]` | 20-bit label | Inserts 4-byte `0x8847` MPLS shim (`exp 0`, `bos 1`, `mpls_ttl 64` defaults) |

| **L3 Hop/QoS** | `ttl <0..255>` / `dscp <0..63>` / `ecn <0..3>` | Semantic range-checked | Sets IPv4 TTL or IPv6 Hop Limit (`64` default) and TOS / Traffic Class (`(dscp << 2) \| ecn`) |

| **L3 IPv6** | `flowlabel <0..1048575>` | `0..0xFFFFF` (20-bit) | Sets IPv6 Flow Label; silently ignored on IPv4 so dual-stack flows stay portable |

| **L3 IPv4 Frag** | `ipid <u16>` / `df` / `mf` / `fragoffset <0..8191>` | Offset in 8-byte blocks | Sets IPv4 ID (`0` default), Don't Fragment (`0x4000`), More Fragments (`0x2000`), and 13-bit offset |

| **L4 Ports** | `srcport <u16>` / `dstport <u16>` | `0..65535` | Overrides transport ports and updates `EndpointPairPorts` memory |

| **L4 Transport** | `transport <tcp\|udp>` | `tcp` or `udp` | Overrides default L4 transport on dual-transport L7 protocols |

| **Payload** | `payload "<str>"` \| `hexpayload "<hex>"` | Escaped UTF-8 or even hex | Appends application/trailer bytes (`hexpayload` strips spaces and colons) |

| **Timing** | `wait <u32><ns\|us\|ms\|s\|m>` | Positive int + unit | Advances PCAPNG clock prior to emitting this frame (`10ms` default) |



**Common QoS Pairings**: Voice (`pcp 5`, `dscp 46` EF); Interactive Video (`pcp 4`, `dscp 34` AF41); Lossless RDMA / Critical Data (`pcp 3`, `dscp 26` AF31); Transactional DB (`pcp 2`, `dscp 18` AF21); Network Management (`dscp 16` CS2); Routing / Control Plane (`pcp 6`, `dscp 48` CS6); Scavenger Bulk (`pcp 1`, `dei 1`, `dscp 8` CS1).



---



## 5. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 2 Switching & Data-Link Protocols (8 Protocols)



### 5.1 `ARP` (RFC 826 / RFC 5227 — EtherType `0x0806`, Polymorphic IPv6 NDP Adaptation)

* **Syntax**: `arp [request | reply] [gratuitous | garp] [sha|sendermac <mac>] [spa|senderip <ipv4>] [tha|targetmac <mac>] [tpa|targetip <ipv4>]`

* **Wire Behavior**: Over IPv4, emits a 28-byte ARP payload (`request` = `OPER 1`, broadcast `ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff`, `THA 00:00:00:00:00:00`; `reply` = `OPER 2`, unicast `dst_mac`; `gratuitous` sets `TPA = SPA` and `THA = 00:00:00:00:00:00`; RFC 5227 ACD probes use `senderip 0.0.0.0`). Over IPv6 host pairs, `arp request` automatically emits an RFC 4861 ICMPv6 Neighbor Solicitation (`Type 135`, `Hop Limit 255`) to Solicited-Node multicast `ff02::1:ffxx:xxxx`, and `arp reply` emits a Neighbor Advertisement (`Type 136`, flags `0x60`).



### 5.2 `VLAN` (IEEE 802.1Q — TPID `0x8100`) & `QINQ` (IEEE 802.1ad — S-Tag `0x88A8` + C-Tag `0x8100`)

* **Syntax**: `vlan <1..4094> [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0..1>]` and `qinq <1..4094> [inner_vlan <1..4094>] [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0..1>]`

* **Wire Behavior**: Used either as encapsulation modifiers ahead of any L3–L7 protocol or as standalone statements (synthesizing a valid inner IP + empty UDP packet when `payload`/`hexpayload` is empty). Never combine `qinq` and `vlan` on the same statement; use `qinq <s_vid> inner_vlan <c_vid>`.



### 5.3 `LLDP` (IEEE 802.1AB — EtherType `0x88CC`, Dst MAC `01:80:c2:00:00:0e`)

* **Syntax**: `lldp [chassis_id "<str>"] [port_id "<str>"|<u16>] [ttl <0..255>] [sysname "<str>"] [sysdesc "<str>"]`

* **Wire Behavior**: Emits mandatory Chassis ID (Type `1`, Subtype `4`, defaults to `src_mac`), Port ID (Type `2`, Subtype `5`, defaults to `"eth0"`), and TTL (Type `3`, default `120`s; `ttl 0` signals LLDP port shutdown), optional System Name (Type `5`) and System Description (Type `6`), optional `hexpayload` TLVs, and End-of-LLDPDU (`0x0000`).



### 5.4 `STP` / `RSTP` (IEEE 802.1D / 802.1w — 802.3 Length + LLC `0x424203`, Dst MAC `01:80:c2:00:00:00`)

* **Syntax**: `stp [rstp] [root_id "<prio>/<mac>"] [bridge_id "<prio>/<mac>"] [port_id <u16>] [cost <u32>] [max_age <u16>] [hello_time <u16>] [forward_delay <u16>] [flags <u8>]`

* **Wire Behavior**: Emits a 35-byte Configuration BPDU (`Version 0, Type 0x00`) or 36-byte Rapid STP BPDU (`rstp`: `Version 2, Type 0x02, Version1Len 0x00`). Always quote `root_id` and `bridge_id` (e.g., `"4096/00:1c:73:00:00:01"` or `"32768:00:1c:73:00:00:02"`). Timers default to `max_age 20`, `hello_time 2`, `forward_delay 15` (scaled by `<< 8`), `port_id 0x8001`, `cost 0`. Common RSTP `flags`: `0x0e` (Proposal + Designated), `0x7c` (Agreement + Root + Learn + Fwd), `0x3c` (Designated + Learn + Fwd), `0x01` (Topology Change).



### 5.5 `LACP` (IEEE 802.3ad / 802.1AX — Slow Protocols `0x8809`, Dst MAC `01:80:c2:00:00:02`)

* **Syntax**: `lacp [actor_sys <mac>] [actor_key <u16>] [actor_port <u16>] [actor_state <u8>] [partner_sys <mac>] [partner_key <u16>] [partner_port <u16>] [partner_state <u8>]`

* **Wire Behavior**: Emits a 110-byte LACPDU (`Subtype 0x01, Version 0x01`, Actor TLV `20B`, Partner TLV `20B`, Collector TLV `16B`, Terminator, `50B` pad). State bitmask (`0x3d` default): `0x01` Active, `0x02` Short Timeout, `0x04` Aggregatable, `0x08` In-Sync, `0x10` Collecting, `0x20` Distributing, `0x40` Defaulted, `0x80` Expired (`0x3f` = active fast-timeout synced bundle; `0x47` = initial unbundled defaulted port).



### 5.6 `EAPOL` (IEEE 802.1X / RFC 3748 — EtherType `0x888E`, Dst MAC `01:80:c2:00:00:03`)

* **Syntax**: `eapol [version <u8>] [[type] <eap_packet | start | logoff | key>] [eap_code <1..4>] [eap_id <u8>] [eap_method <u8>] [identity "<str>"]`

* **Wire Behavior**: `eap_code`: `1` Request, `2` Response, `3` Success (strict 4-byte RFC 3748 §4.2 EAP frame), `4` Failure (4-byte EAP frame). `eap_method`: `1` Identity, `4` MD5, `13` EAP-TLS, `21` TTLS, `25` PEAP, `50` EAP-AKA'.



### 5.7 `MPLS` (RFC 3032 / RFC 5462 — EtherType `0x8847`)

* **Syntax**: `mpls <0..1048575> [label <u32>] [exp|tc <0..7>] [bos <0|1>] [mpls_ttl <u8>]`



```frameassembly

host sw_a { ip 10.1.0.1 mac 00:1c:73:01:00:01 }

host sw_b { ip 10.1.0.2 mac 00:1c:73:01:00:02 }



flow l2_control_and_trunking(a, b) {

    a -> b lldp chassis_id "00:1c:73:01:00:01" port_id "Ethernet1/1" ttl 120 sysname "leaf-01" wait 2ms

    a -> b stp rstp root_id "4096/00:1c:73:01:00:01" bridge_id "4096/00:1c:73:01:00:01" port_id 0x8001 cost 0 flags 0x3c wait 2ms

    a -> b lacp actor_sys 00:1c:73:01:00:01 actor_key 10 actor_port 1 actor_state 0x3f partner_sys 00:1c:73:01:00:02 partner_key 10 partner_port 1 partner_state 0x3f wait 2ms

    a -> b qinq 2500 inner_vlan 100 pcp 5 arp request gratuitous sendermac 00:1c:73:01:00:01 senderip 10.1.0.1 targetip 10.1.0.1

}



compile { l2_control_and_trunking(sw_a, sw_b) }

```

## 6. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 3 Control, Tunneling, VPN, Routing & FHRP Protocols (20 Protocols)



| Protocol | Default Transport / Target | Complete Protocol-Scoped Syntax & Defaults |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **`icmp`** | IP `1` (v4) / `58` (v6) | `icmp [echo_request\|echo_reply\|dest_unreach\|time_exceeded\|redirect] [type <u8>] [code <u8>] [id <u16>] [seq <u32>] [gateway <ipv4>]` (`echo_request` default: `8` v4 / `128` v6; `id 0x1234`, `seq 1`) |

| **`ndp`** | IPv6 `58` (`ttl=255`) | `ndp [neighbor_solicit\|neighbor_advert\|router_solicit\|router_advert] [target <ipv6>] [slla <mac>] [tlla <mac>] [router_lifetime <u16>]` (`neighbor_solicit` auto-targets `ff02::1:ffxx:xxxx`; `router_solicit` targets `ff02::2`) |

| **`igmp`** | IPv4 `2` | `igmp [query\|report\|leave] [v1\|v2\|v3\|version <1..3>] [group <ipv4>] [max_resp <u8>]` (`report` v2 `0x16` to `239.1.1.1` default; `query` to `224.0.0.1`; `v3 report` `0x22` to `224.0.0.22`; `leave` to `224.0.0.2`) |

| **`mld`** | IPv6 `58` | `mld [query\|report\|done] [multicast_addr <ipv6>] [max_resp_delay <u16>]` (`report` `131` to `ff02::1` default; `done` `132` to `ff02::2`) |

| **`gre`** | IP `47` | `gre [gre_key\|key <u32>] [gre_seq <u32>] [gre_proto <u16>] [checksum]` (`gre_proto 0x0800` default; `checksum` sets `C` bit `0x8000` and RFC 1071 checksum) |

| **`vxlan`** | UDP `4789` | `vxlan [vni\|vnid <0..16777215>]` (`vni 4096` default; auto-synthesizes 42-byte inner Ethernet+IPv4+UDP frame when `payload` is empty) |

| **`geneve`** | UDP `6081` | `geneve [vni\|vnid <0..16777215>] [opt_class <u16>] [opt_type <u8>] [protocol_type <u16>]` (`protocol_type 0x6558` TEB default; auto-synthesizes inner Ethernet+IPv4+UDP frame when empty) |

| **`ikev2`** | UDP `500` (`4500` NAT-T) | `ikev2 [[exchange] <sa_init\|create_child_sa\|informational>] [initiator_spi <u64>] [responder_spi <u64>] [msgid <u32>] [flags <u8>] [next_payload <u8>]` (`sa_init` `34` default; `flags 0x08` Initiator, `0x20` Response) |

| **`ipsec`** / **`esp`**| IP `50` | `esp` (or `ipsec`) `[spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [iv "<hex>"] [icv "<hex>"] [next_header <u8>]` (`spi 0x1000`, `seq 1`, `8B` IV, `12B` ICV, `next_header 59` defaults) |

| **`ah`** | IP `51` | `ah [spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [icv "<hex>"] [next_header <u8>]` (`spi 0x2000`, `seq 1`, `12B` ICV, `next_header 59` defaults) |

| **`wireguard`**| UDP `51820` (LE fields) | `wireguard [[type] <initiation\|response\|cookie\|data>] [sender <u32>] [receiver <u32>] [counter <u64>]` (`initiation` = 148B, `response` = 92B, `cookie` = 64B, `data` $\ge 32\text{B}$) |

| **`ospf`** | IP `89` -> `224.0.0.5`/`ff02::5`| `ospf [hello\|dbd\|lsr\|lsu\|lsack] [router_id <ipv4>] [area_id <u32\|ipv4>] [hello_interval <u16>] [dead_interval <u32>] [priority <u16>]` (`hello` default, `hello_interval 10`, `dead_interval 40`) |

| **`bgp`** | TCP `179` (4-tuple tracked)| `bgp [open\|update\|notification\|keepalive] [asn <u32>] [holdtime <u16>] [bgpid <ipv4>] [prefix\|nlri "<cidr>"] [nexthop <ip>]` (`prefix` takes a **quoted CIDR string**; `update` encodes `ORIGIN`, `AS_PATH`, `NEXT_HOP`, and NLRI) |

| **`rip`** | UDP `520` (v4) / `521` (v6)| `rip [request\|response\|reply] [prefix <ip>] [metric <1..16>] [nexthop <ip>] [tag <u16>]` (targets `224.0.0.9`/`ff02::9`; `prefix` takes an **unquoted IP**) |

| **`pim`** | IP `103` -> `224.0.0.13`/`ff02::d`| `pim [hello\|join_prune\|register] [group <ip>] [source <ip>] [rp <ip>] [holdtime <u16>] [dr_priority <u32>]` |

| **`vrrp`** | IP `112` (`ttl=255`) | `vrrp [vrid <1..255>] [priority <0..255>] [adv_int <u16>] [vip <ip>] [version <2\|3>]` (targets `224.0.0.18`/`ff02::12`; `version 3` default with IPv4/IPv6 pseudo-header checksum) |

| **`hsrp`** | UDP `1985` (v4) / `2029` (v6)| `hsrp [group <u8>] [priority <u16>] [state <u8>] [hellotime <u8>] [holdtime <u16>] [auth "<str>"] [vip <ip>]` (targets `224.0.0.2`/`ff02::66`; `state 16` Active, `auth "cisco"` defaults) |

| **`bfd`** | UDP `3784` | `bfd [state <0..3>] [diag <0..31>] [my_disc <u32>] [your_disc <u32>] [min_tx <u32>] [min_rx <u32>] [mult <u8>]` (`state`: `0` AdminDown, `1` Down, `2` Init, `3` Up default; timers in $\mu\text{s}$) |

| **`openflow`**| TCP `6653` | `openflow [[type] <hello\|echo_req\|echo_request\|echo_reply\|features_req\|features_reply\|packet_in\|packet_out\|flow_mod>] [version <u8>] [xid <u32>] [dpid <u64>] [table_id <u8>] [priority <u16>]` (`version 4` = OF 1.3 default) |

## 7. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 4 Transport Protocols (3 Protocols: `TCP`, `UDP`, `SCTP`)



### 7.1 `TCP` (RFC 9293 / RFC 7323 — IP Protocol `6`)

* **Syntax**: `tcp [syn] [ack] [fin] [rst] [psh] [urg] [ece] [cwr] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [seq <u32>] [acknum <u32>] [win|window <u16>] [urgent <u16>] [mss <u16>] [wscale <u8>] [sack_perm|sackperm] [tsval <u32>] [tsecr <u32>]`

* **Override Mechanics**: Supplying `seq <u32>` resynchronizes that peer's 4-tuple stream sequence counter (ideal for retransmissions or out-of-window probes); `win 0` synthesizes a TCP ZeroWindow stall.



### 7.2 `UDP` (RFC 768 / RFC 8200 — IP Protocol `17`)

* **Syntax**: `udp [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [payload "<str>" | hexpayload "<hex>"]`

* **Checksum Rule**: Computes 16-bit one's-complement pseudo-header checksum across IPv4 and IPv6, folding `0x0000` to `0xFFFF` per RFC 8200 §8.1. TCP flags/options on `udp` are rejected by `validate_semantics`.



### 7.3 `SCTP` (RFC 9260 — IP Protocol `132`, Little-Endian Castagnoli `CRC32c`)

* **Syntax**: `sctp [[chunk] <init | init_ack | cookie_echo | cookie_ack | data | sack | heartbeat | heartbeat_ack | shutdown | abort>] [vtag <u32>] [tsn <u32>] [stream <u16>] [ssn <u16>] [ppid <u32>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>]`

* **Common Telecom `PPID` & Port Pairs**: `ppid 3` (`dstport 2905` SS7 M3UA); `ppid 18` (`dstport 36412` 4G LTE S1AP); `ppid 27` (`dstport 36422` X2AP); `ppid 46` (`dstport 3868` Diameter); `ppid 60` (`dstport 38412` 5G Core N2 NGAP).



### 7.4 The 9 Dual-Transport Layer 7 Protocols (`transport tcp` vs `transport udp`)

* **Default TCP $\rightarrow$ Override with `transport udp` (5)**: `modbus` (`502`), `nfs` (`2049`), `memcached` (`11211`), `dnp3` (`20000`), `ethernetip` (`44818`).

* **Default UDP $\rightarrow$ Override with `transport tcp` (4)**: `dns` (`53`, auto-prepends 2-byte RFC 1035 TCP length), `sip` (`5060`), `syslog` (`514`), `kerberos` (`88`).



---



## 8. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 7 Network Management (`SNMP1`, `SNMP2`, `SNMP3` USM — 3 Protocols)



### 8.1 PDU Routing & All 9 SMI `VARBIND` Types

* **Automatic Port Selection**: `trap` and `inform` default to **UDP `162`**; `get`, `getnext`, `getbulk`, `set`, and `response` default to **UDP `161`**.

* **`varbind` Syntax** (repeatable per statement):

  * `varbind <oid> null` (or `nullval`) — ASN.1 `NULL` (`0x05`) for poll requests

  * `varbind <oid> string "<text>"` — `OCTET STRING` (`0x04`)

  * `varbind <oid> int <i32>` — signed 32-bit `INTEGER` (`0x02`)

  * `varbind <oid> timeticks <u32>` — `TimeTicks` (`0x43`, $1/100\text{ s}$)

  * `varbind <oid> ipval <ip>` — `IpAddress` (`0x40` for IPv4; `0x04` 16B `InetAddress` for IPv6)

  * `varbind <oid> oidval <oid>` — `OBJECT IDENTIFIER` (`0x06`; first arc `0..2`, second arc `< 40` when first `< 2`)

  * `varbind <oid> counter32 <u32>` — `Counter32` (`0x41`)

  * `varbind <oid> gauge32 <u32>` — `Gauge32` (`0x42`)

  * `varbind <oid> counter64 <u64>` — `Counter64` (`0x46`, valid in `snmp2` and `snmp3` **only**; rejected in `snmp1`)



### 8.2 Protocol-Specific Rules (`SNMP1`, `SNMP2`, `SNMP3`)

* **`snmp1` (RFC 1157)**: `snmp1 [trap|get|getnext|set|response] [community "<str>"] [enterprise <oid>] [oid <oid>] [agentip <ipv4>] [gentrap <0..6>] [spectrap <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [varbind ...]`. `gentrap`: `0` coldStart, `1` warmStart, `2` linkDown, `3` linkUp, `4` authenticationFailure, `5` egpNeighborLoss, `6` enterpriseSpecific. Over IPv6, `agentip` automatically falls back to `0.0.0.0` per RFC 3584 §3.2. `getbulk` and `inform` are rejected on `snmp1`.

* **`snmp2` (RFC 3416)**: `snmp2 [trap|inform|get|getnext|getbulk|set|response] [community "<str>"] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind ...]`. On `trap` and `inform`, FrameAssembly automatically prepends `sysUpTime.0` (`1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0`) and `snmpTrapOID.0` (`1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.4.1.0`, defaulting to `1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3` `linkDown`) ahead of user `varbind` entries.

* **`snmp3` (RFC 3414 / 3826 / 7860 USM)**: `snmp3 [trap|inform|get|getnext|getbulk|set|response] [user "<str>"] [engineid "<even_hex>"] [engineboots <u32>] [enginetime <u32>] [contextname "<str>"] [auth <md5|sha|sha256|sha384|sha512> "<pass>"] [priv <des|aes> "<pass>"] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind ...]`.

  * **3 Security Levels**: Omit `auth`/`priv` $\rightarrow$ `noAuthNoPriv` (e.g., EngineID discovery with `user "" engineid ""`); specify `auth` only $\rightarrow$ `authNoPriv`; specify both `auth` and `priv` $\rightarrow$ `authPriv` (`priv` without `auth` is rejected). `community` is rejected on `snmp3`.

  * **CLI Decryption Verification**: `tshark -r out.pcap -o 'uat:snmp_users:"80001f8801","netops","SHA2-256","AuthPass123!","AES","PrivPass123!"' -V`



---



## 9. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 7 Infrastructure, Time, AAA & Flow Telemetry (11 Protocols)



| Protocol | Port & Smart Routing | Complete Protocol-Scoped Syntax & Wire Behavior |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **`dns`** | UDP `53` (`transport tcp` $\rightarrow$ TCP `53` + 2B len) | `dns [query\|response] [txid <u16>] [qname "<domain>"] [qtype "<A\|AAAA\|PTR\|CNAME\|MX\|TXT\|SRV\|NS\|SOA\|AXFR\|ANY\|u16>"] [rdata "<val>"] [rcode <0..15>] [ans_ttl <u32>]` (`rcode`: `0` NOERROR, `2` SERVFAIL, `3` NXDOMAIN, `5` REFUSED; `response` or `rdata` appends compressed `0xC00C` answer RR) |

| **`mdns`** | UDP `5353` -> `224.0.0.251` / `ff02::fb` | `mdns [query\|response] [txid <u16>] [qname "<domain>"] [qtype "<type>"] [rdata "<val>"] [rcode <0..15>] [ans_ttl <u32>]` (auto-derives multicast IP & MAC) |

| **`dhcp`** | UDP `68<->67` (v4) / `546<->547` (v6) | `dhcp [discover\|offer\|request\|ack\|release\|solicit\|advertise\|reply] [xid <u32>] [ciaddr <ipv4>] [yiaddr <ip>] [siaddr <ipv4>] [chaddr <mac>] [hostname "<str>"] [dns_server <ip>] [router <ipv4>] [subnet_mask <ipv4>] [lease_time <u32>]` (v4 builds 236B BOOTP + `0x63825363` cookie + Options `53,1,3,6,12,51,255`; v6 builds RFC 8415 msg + DUID-LL) |

| **`ntp`** | UDP `123` | `ntp [li <0..3>] [vn <1..4>] [mode <0..7>] [stratum <0..16>] [poll <u8>] [precision <i32>] [refid "<4char>"] [tx_timestamp <u64>]` (48B header; `mode 3` client, `mode 4` server, `mode 5` broadcast) |

| **`ptp`** | UDP `319` (Event) / `320` (General) | `ptp [sync\|delay_req\|follow_up\|delay_resp\|announce\|msg_type "<str>"] [domain <u8>] [seq_id <u16>] [clock_id "<str>"]` (44B IEEE 1588v2 frame; `sync`/`delay_req` route to `319`; `follow_up`/`delay_resp`/`announce` route to `320`; EUI-64 `clock_id` auto-derived from `src_mac` when omitted) |

| **`radius`** | UDP `1812` (Auth) / `1813` (Acct) | `radius [access_request\|access_accept\|access_reject\|access_challenge\|accounting_request\|accounting_response\|code "<str>"] [id <u8>] [user "<str>"] [nas_ip <ip>] [service_type <u32>] [framed_ip <ip>]` (IPv6 `nas_ip`/`framed_ip` automatically emit RFC 3162 AVP `95` and RFC 6911 AVP `168`) |

| **`tacacs`** | TCP `49` | `tacacs [[type] <authen\|author\|acct>] [seq <u8>] [flags <u8>] [session_id <u32>] [user "<str>"] [data "<str>"]` (`flags 1` unencrypted cleartext body default) |

| **`syslog`** | UDP `514` (`transport tcp` $\rightarrow$ TCP `514`) | `syslog [facility <0..23>] [severity <0..7>] [pri <0..191>] [hostname "<str>"] [app "<str>"] [procid "<str>"] [msgid "<str>"] [msg "<str>"]` (`PRI = facility * 8 + severity` unless `pri` is set; emits RFC 5424 record) |

| **`netflow`** | UDP `2055` | `netflow [srcip <ipv4>] [dstip <ipv4>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [proto <u8>] [packets <u32>] [octets <u32>]` (72B Cisco NetFlow v5 header + flow record) |

| **`ipfix`** | UDP `4739` | `ipfix [domain_id <u32>] [srcip <ipv4>] [dstip <ipv4>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [proto <u8>] [packets <u32>] [octets <u32>]` (RFC 7011 v10 header + Set ID `256` data record) |

| **`sflow`** | UDP `6343` | `sflow [agent_ip\|agentip <ip>] [sub_agent_id <u32>] [seq <u32>] [uptime <u32>] [samples <u32>]` (dual-stack v5 datagram + Format `1` flow sample) |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **`http2`** | TCP `443` | `http2 [preface] [settings\|headers\|data\|window_update\|ping\|goaway] [stream_id <u32>]` (`preface` emits 24B `PRI * HTTP/2.0...`; frame types emit 9B RFC 9113 binary header) |

| **`tls`** | TCP `443` | `tls [client_hello\|server_hello\|certificate\|finished\|app_data\|alert] [record_version <u16>] [handshake_version <u16>] [sni "<host>"] [ciphersuite <u16>] [alpn "<proto>"]` (`record_version 0x0303`, `ciphersuite 0x1301` / `4865` `TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256` defaults; encodes `0x0000` SNI & `0x0010` ALPN extensions) |

| **`ssh`** | TCP `22` | `ssh [banner "<str>"] [kexinit] [newkeys] [msg_code <u8>] [cookie "<32hex_or_str>"]` (defaults to `"SSH-2.0-FrameAssembly_1.0\r\n"`; `kexinit`/`newkeys`/`msg_code` emit 8-byte-padded RFC 4253 binary packet) |

| **`telnet`** | TCP `23` | `telnet [will [option] <u8>] [wont [option] <u8>] [do [option] <u8>] [dont [option] <u8>] [option <u8>] [data "<str>"]` (`0xFF` IAC sequences + NVT-ASCII `data`) |

| **`tftp`** | UDP `69` | `tftp [rrq\|wrq\|data\|ack\|err\|error] [filename "<str>"] [mode "<str>"] [block <u16>] [errcode <u16>] [errmsg "<str>"]` (RFC 1350 opcodes `1..5`) |

| **`ftp`** | TCP `21` | `ftp [cmd "<verb>"] [arg "<str>"] [code <u16>] [reply "<str>"]` (if `code` or `reply` is set, emits `<code> <reply>\r\n`; else `<cmd> [arg]\r\n`) |

| **`whois`** | TCP `43` | `whois [query\|response] [domain "<str>"] [registrar "<str>"]` |

| **`sip`** | UDP/TCP `5060` | `sip [invite\|ack\|bye\|cancel\|register\|options\|method "<verb>"] [uri "<uri>"] [status <u16>] [reason "<str>"] [from "<uri>"] [to "<uri>"] [call_id "<id>"] [cseq <u32>] [via "<str>"] [contact "<uri>"] [content_type "<mime>"] [body "<sdp>"] [transport tcp]` |

| **`rtp`** | UDP `5004` | `rtp [pt <0..127>] [seq <u16>] [timestamp <u32>] [ssrc <u32>] [marker <0\|1>]` (12B RFC 3550 header + 160B G.711 silence default if `payload` omitted) |

| **`rtsp`** | TCP `554` | `rtsp [options\|describe\|setup\|play\|teardown\|method "<verb>"] [uri "<url>"] [status <u16>] [cseq <u32>] [transport_hdr "<str>"] [session "<id>"]` |

| **`stun`** | UDP `3478` | `stun [binding_request\|binding_response\|binding_error] [txid <u32>] [xor_mapped_addr <ip>] [software "<str>"]` (20B header with `0x2112A442` magic cookie + XORed IPv4/IPv6 `0x0020` TLV) |

| **`ssdp`** | UDP `1900` | `ssdp [msearch\|notify] [host_hdr "<ip:port>"] [man "<str>"] [mx <u8>] [st "<str>"] [nt "<str>"] [nts "<str>"] [usn "<str>"] [location "<url>"]` |

## 11. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 7 Mail, Identity, Storage, Databases, Caches & Brokers (14 Protocols)



| Protocol | Default Port | Complete Protocol-Scoped Syntax & Wire Behavior |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **`smtp`** | TCP `25` | `smtp [ehlo ["<dom>"]\|helo ["<dom>"]\|mail_from ["<addr>"]\|rcpt_to ["<addr>"]\|quit\|cmd "<verb>"] [param "<arg>"] [code <u16>] [reply "<str>"] [body "<mime>"]` (use `cmd "DATA"` for the `DATA` command line; `body "..."` appends `\r\n.\r\n`) |

| **`imap`** | TCP `143` | `imap [tag "<tag>"] [cmd "<verb>"] [arg "<str>"] [status "<OK\|NO\|BAD>"] [response "<str>"]` |

| **`pop3`** | TCP `110` | `pop3 [cmd "<verb>"] [arg "<str>"] [ok\|err] [response "<str>"]` (`ok` emits `+OK`, `err` emits `-ERR`) |

| **`kerberos`**| UDP/TCP `88` | `kerberos [as_req\|as_rep\|tgs_req\|tgs_rep\|krb_error] [realm "<REALM>"] [cname "<user>"] [sname "<svc>"] [etype <u32>] [transport tcp]` (RFC 4120 ASN.1 DER tags `0x6A`, `0x6B`, `0x6C`, `0x6D`, `0x7E`; default `etype 18` AES256) |

| **`ldap`** | TCP `389` | `ldap [bind_req\|bind_res\|search_req\|search_entry\|search_done\|unbind_req] [msgid <u32>] [base_dn "<dn>"] [filter "<expr>"] [result_code <u32>]` (complete RFC 4511 ASN.1 BER `LDAPMessage` `0x30`) |

| **`smb`** | TCP `445` | `smb [negotiate\|session_setup\|tree_connect\|create\|tree_disconnect\|command "<LOGOFF\|CLOSE\|READ\|WRITE\|...>"] [status <u32>] [tree_id <u32>] [session_id <u64>] [msgid <u64>] [share "<unc>"] [filename "<name>"]` (4B NetBIOS + 64B `\xFESMB` header + UTF-16LE paths; use `"\\\\srv\\share"` for UNC paths) |

| **`nfs`** | TCP/UDP `2049` | `nfs [compound\|proc "<NULL\|GETATTR\|LOOKUP\|READ\|WRITE\|COMPOUND>"] [vers <2\|3\|4>] [xid <u32>] [tag "<str>"] [path "<path>"] [transport udp]` (4B RPC Record Marking + 40B ONC-RPC v2 Call Program `100003` + XDR padding) |

| **`redis`** | TCP `6379` | `redis [get\|set\|cmd "<verb>"] [key "<key>"] [args "<arg>"...] [reply_type "<SIMPLE\|STATUS\|ERROR\|ERR\|INTEGER\|INT\|BULK>"] [value "<val>"]` (`args` may be repeated to push multiple RESP bulk strings) |

| **`memcached`**| TCP/UDP `11211` | `memcached [get\|set\|cmd "<verb>"] [key "<key>"] [value "<val>"] [flags <u32>] [exptime <u32>] [opcode <u8>] [opaque <u32>] [cas <u64>] [transport udp]` (emits 24B `0x80` Binary Protocol if `opcode`, `opaque`, or `cas` is set; else ASCII protocol) |

| **`mysql`** | TCP `3306` | `mysql [greeting\|login\|query\|ok\|err\|eof] [server_version "<ver>"] [user "<user>"] [db "<db>"] [sql "<sql>"] [errcode <u16>]` (3B LE length + seq `0` + Protocol v10 `HandshakeV10` / `HandshakeResponse41` / `COM_QUERY` `0x03`) |

| **`postgres`**| TCP `5432` | `postgres [startup\|query\|auth_ok\|command_complete\|ready_for_query\|error_response] [user "<role>"] [db "<db>"] [sql "<sql>"]` (v3.0 `0x00030000` `StartupMessage` or `'Q'`/`'R'`/`'C'`/`'Z'`/`'E'` frames) |

| **`mqtt`** | TCP `1883` | `mqtt [connect\|connack\|publish\|puback\|subscribe\|suback\|pingreq\|pingresp\|disconnect\|pkt_type "<type>"] [client_id "<id>"] [topic "<topic>"] [qos <0..2>] [retain [0\|1]] [pkt_id <u16>] [keepalive <u16>] [return_code <u8>]` |

| **`coap`** | UDP `5683` | `coap [con\|non\|ack\|rst\|msg_type "<type>"] [get\|post\|put\|delete\|created\|changed\|not_found\|code "<c.dd>"] [msgid <u16>] [token <u32\|"<hex>">] [uri_path "<path>"] [content_format <u16>]` (4B RFC 7252 header + Option `11`/`12` delta encoding + `0xFF` payload marker) |

| **`amqp`** | TCP `5672` | `amqp [protocol_header\|connection_start\|channel_open\|basic_publish\|basic_deliver\|heartbeat] [channel <u16>] [exchange "<name>"] [routing_key "<key>"]` (`AMQP\x00\x00\x09\x01` preface or Method/Heartbeat frames ending in `0xCE`) |



---



## 12. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Layer 7 Industrial Control Systems (ICS) & SCADA/OT (6 Protocols)



| Protocol | Default Port | Complete Protocol-Scoped Syntax & Wire Behavior |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **`modbus`** | TCP/UDP `502` | `modbus [read_coils\|read_discrete_inputs\|read_holding_registers\|read_input_registers\|write_single_coil\|write_single_register\|write_multiple_registers\|func "<name>"] [txid <u16>] [proto_id <u16>] [unitid <u8>] [addr <u16>] [count <u16>] [value <u16>] [is_response] [transport udp]` (7B MBAP header + Function `0x01..0x06, 0x10`; use `is_response` for PLC replies) |

| **`bacnet`** | UDP `47808` (`0xBAC0`) | `bacnet [who_is\|i_am\|read_property\|write_property] [invoke_id <u8>] [object_type <u16>] [object_instance <u32>] [property_id <u32>] [value <u32>]` (4B BVLC `0x81` + 2B NPDU + APDU; `property_id 85` = `Present_Value`) |

| **`dnp3`** | TCP/UDP `20000` | `dnp3 [confirm\|read\|write\|select\|operate\|direct_operate\|unsolicited_response\|func "<RESPONSE\|...>"] [src <u16>] [dst <u16>] [group <u8>] [variation <u8>] [crc <u16>] [transport udp]` (10B `0x0564` Data Link header + `0xC0` Transport + App header + automatic reflected `0xA653` CRC-16 on header and every 16B chunk; use `func "RESPONSE"` for outstation replies) |

| **`s7comm`** | TCP `102` | `s7comm [setup_comm\|read_var\|write_var\|plc_control\|func "<name>"] [rosctr "<JOB\|ACK\|ACK_DATA\|USERDATA>"] [pdu_ref <u16>] [area <u8\|"<DB\|MK\|PE\|PA\|CT\|TM>">] [db_num <u16>] [offset <u32>] [count <u16>]` (4B TPKT + 3B COTP + S7 `0x32` header + `S7ANY` pointer shifting `offset << 3`) |

| **`ethernetip`**| TCP/UDP `44818` | `ethernetip [list_identity\|list_services\|list_interfaces\|register_session\|unregister_session\|send_rr_data\|send_unit_data\|cmd "<NOP\|...>"] [session_handle <u32>] [status <u32>] [context <u64>] [cip_service <u8>] [cip_class <u16>] [cip_instance <u16>] [cip_attr <u16>] [transport udp]` (24B LE Encapsulation Header + CPF + CIP EPATH) |

| **`opcua`** | TCP `4840` | `opcua [msg_type "<HEL\|ACK\|OPN\|CLO\|MSG\|ERR>"] [chunk_type "<F\|C\|A>"] [secure_channel_id <u32>] [token_id <u32>] [seq_num <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [endpoint_url "<url>"] [node_id "<id>"]` (8B LE UACP header + buffer sizes or SecureChannel + String `NodeId`) |



---



## 13. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Formal ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF Grammar & Constrained Decoding



For hardware-speed logit masking during LLM inference, use the repository's synchronized decoding grammars directly:

* **`llama.cpp` / `XGrammar` (`frameassembly.gbnf`)**: `llama-cli -m model.gguf --grammar-file frameassembly.gbnf -p "..."` (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/frameassembly.gbnf`)

* **`Outlines` / `vLLM` / `SGLang` (`frameassembly.lark`)**: `outlines.generate.cfg(model, lark_str)` (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/frameassembly.lark`)



```ebnf

(* FrameAssembly Formal Grammar (ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF, synchronized with src/parser/) *)

(* All keyword, protocol, modifier, and time_unit terminals are ASCII case-insensitive. *)



program                 = { top_level_decl } , compile_block , { top_level_decl } ;

top_level_decl          = host_declaration | flow_declaration ;



host_declaration        = "HOST" , identifier , "{" , { host_property } , "}" ;

host_property           = ( "IP" , ip_address ) | ( "MAC" , mac_address ) ;



flow_declaration        = "FLOW" , identifier , "(" , [ param_list ] , ")" ,

                          "{" , { frame_statement } , "}" ;

param_list              = identifier , { "," , identifier } ;



frame_statement         = identifier , ( "->" | "<-" ) , identifier , { frame_field } ;



compile_block           = "COMPILE" , "{" , { run_statement } , "}" ;

run_statement           = flow_invocation | loop_block ;

loop_block              = "LOOP" , unsigned_int , "{" , { flow_invocation } , "}" ;

flow_invocation         = identifier , "(" , [ param_list ] , ")" ;



frame_field             = protocol_keyword | universal_modifier | l2_modifier

                        | l3_modifier | l4_modifier | l2_protocol_field

                        | l3_protocol_field | l4_protocol_field

                        | snmp_protocol_field | l7_protocol_field ;



protocol_keyword        = "ARP" | "VLAN" | "QINQ" | "LLDP" | "STP" | "LACP" | "EAPOL" | "MPLS"

                        | "ICMP" | "NDP" | "IGMP" | "MLD" | "GRE" | "VXLAN" | "GENEVE"

                        | "IPSEC" | "ESP" | "AH" | "IKEV2" | "WIREGUARD"

                        | "OSPF" | "BGP" | "RIP" | "VRRP" | "HSRP" | "PIM" | "BFD" | "OPENFLOW"

                        | "TCP" | "UDP" | "SCTP" | "SNMP1" | "SNMP2" | "SNMP3"

                        | "DNS" | "MDNS" | "DHCP" | "NTP" | "PTP" | "RADIUS" | "TACACS"

                        | "SYSLOG" | "NETFLOW" | "IPFIX" | "SFLOW"

                        | "TFTP" | "FTP" | "SSH" | "TELNET" | "HTTP" | "HTTP2" | "GRPC"

                        | "WEBSOCKET" | "TLS" | "QUIC" | "STUN" | "SIP" | "RTP" | "RTSP"

                        | "SMTP" | "IMAP" | "POP3" | "KERBEROS" | "LDAP" | "SMB" | "NFS"

                        | "REDIS" | "MEMCACHED" | "MYSQL" | "POSTGRES" | "MQTT" | "COAP"

                        | "AMQP" | "SSDP" | "WHOIS"

                        | "MODBUS" | "BACNET" | "DNP3" | "S7COMM" | "ETHERNETIP" | "OPCUA" ;



universal_modifier      = ( "WAIT" , unsigned_int , ( "ns" | "us" | "ms" | "s" | "m" ) )

                        | ( "PAYLOAD" , string_literal )

                        | ( "HEXPAYLOAD" , hex_string_literal ) ;



l2_modifier             = ( "SRCMAC" , mac_address ) | ( "DSTMAC" , mac_address )

                        | ( "ETHERTYPE" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "VLAN" , [ unsigned_int ] ) | ( "PCP" , unsigned_int ) | ( "DEI" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "QINQ" , [ unsigned_int ] ) | ( "INNER_VLAN" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "MPLS" , [ unsigned_int ] ) | ( "LABEL" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( ( "EXP" | "TC" ) , unsigned_int ) | ( "BOS" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "MPLS_TTL" , unsigned_int ) ;



l3_modifier             = ( "TTL" , unsigned_int ) | ( "DSCP" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "ECN" , unsigned_int ) | ( "FLOWLABEL" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "IPID" , unsigned_int ) | "DF" | "MF"

                        | ( "FRAGOFFSET" , unsigned_int ) | ( "NEXT_HEADER" , unsigned_int ) ;



l4_modifier             = ( "SRCPORT" , unsigned_int ) | ( "DSTPORT" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "TRANSPORT" , ( "TCP" | "UDP" ) ) | tcp_flag

                        | ( "SEQ" , unsigned_int ) | ( "ACKNUM" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( ( "WIN" | "WINDOW" ) , unsigned_int ) | ( "URGENT" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "MSS" , unsigned_int ) | ( "WSCALE" , unsigned_int )

                        | "SACK_PERM" | "SACKPERM"

                        | ( "TSVAL" , unsigned_int ) | ( "TSECR" , unsigned_int ) ;



tcp_flag                = "SYN" | "ACK" | "FIN" | "RST" | "PSH" | "URG" | "ECE" | "CWR" ;



l2_protocol_field       = "REQUEST" | ( "REPLY" , [ string_literal ] ) | "GRATUITOUS" | "GARP"

                        | ( ( "SHA" | "SENDERMAC" | "THA" | "TARGETMAC" | "ACTOR_SYS" | "PARTNER_SYS" ) , mac_address )

                        | ( ( "SPA" | "SENDERIP" | "TPA" | "TARGETIP" ) , ip_address )

                        | ( ( "CHASSIS_ID" | "SYSNAME" | "SYSDESC" | "ROOT_ID" | "BRIDGE_ID" | "IDENTITY" ) , str_or_ident )

                        | ( "PORT_ID" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )

                        | ( ( "COST" | "MAX_AGE" | "HELLO_TIME" | "FORWARD_DELAY" | "FLAGS"

                            | "ACTOR_KEY" | "ACTOR_PORT" | "ACTOR_STATE"

                            | "PARTNER_KEY" | "PARTNER_PORT" | "PARTNER_STATE"

                            | "EAP_CODE" | "EAP_ID" | "EAP_METHOD" ) , unsigned_int )

                        | "RSTP" | ( "VERSION" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )

                        | ( [ "TYPE" ] , ( "START" | "LOGOFF" | "KEY" | "EAP_PACKET" ) ) ;



l3_protocol_field       = "ECHO_REQUEST" | "ECHO_REPLY" | "DEST_UNREACH" | "TIME_EXCEEDED" | "REDIRECT"

                        | "ROUTER_SOLICIT" | "ROUTER_ADVERT" | "NEIGHBOR_SOLICIT" | "NEIGHBOR_ADVERT"

                        | "QUERY" | "REPORT" | "LEAVE" | "DONE" | "V1" | "V2" | "V3" | "CHECKSUM"

                        | ( [ "EXCHANGE" ] , ( "SA_INIT" | "CREATE_CHILD_SA" | "INFORMATIONAL" ) )

                        | ( [ "TYPE" ] , ( "INITIATION" | "RESPONSE" | "COOKIE" | "DATA"

                                         | "HELLO" | "FEATURES_REQ" | "FEATURES_REPLY" | "PACKET_IN"

                                         | "PACKET_OUT" | "FLOW_MOD" | "ECHO_REQ" ) )

                        | "DBD" | "LSR" | "LSU" | "LSACK" | "OPEN" | "UPDATE" | "NOTIFICATION" | "KEEPALIVE"

                        | "JOIN_PRUNE" | "REGISTER"

                        | ( ( "GATEWAY" | "TARGET" | "MULTICAST_ADDR" | "ROUTER_ID" | "BGPID"

                            | "NEXTHOP" | "VIP" | "SOURCE" | "RP" ) , ip_address )

                        | ( "GROUP" , ( ip_address | unsigned_int ) )

                        | ( "AREA_ID" , ( unsigned_int | ip_address ) )

                        | ( ( "PREFIX" | "NLRI" ) , ( ip_address | str_or_ident ) )

                        | ( ( "SLLA" | "TLLA" ) , mac_address )

                        | ( ( "IV" | "ICV" ) , ( hex_string_literal | unsigned_int ) )

                        | ( ( "TYPE" | "CODE" | "ID" | "ROUTER_LIFETIME" | "MAX_RESP" | "MAX_RESP_DELAY"

                            | "GRE_KEY" | "GRE_SEQ" | "GRE_PROTO" | "VNI" | "VNID" | "OPT_CLASS"

                            | "OPT_TYPE" | "PROTOCOL_TYPE" | "SPI" | "INITIATOR_SPI" | "RESPONDER_SPI"

                            | "MSGID" | "NEXT_PAYLOAD" | "SENDER" | "RECEIVER" | "COUNTER"

                            | "HELLO_INTERVAL" | "DEAD_INTERVAL" | "PRIORITY" | "ASN" | "HOLDTIME"

                            | "METRIC" | "VRID" | "ADV_INT" | "HELLOTIME" | "STATE" | "DR_PRIORITY"

                            | "DIAG" | "MY_DISC" | "YOUR_DISC" | "MIN_TX" | "MIN_RX" | "MULT"

                            | "XID" | "DPID" | "TABLE_ID" ) , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "TAG" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) ) ;



l4_protocol_field       = ( ( "VTAG" | "STREAM" | "SSN" | "PPID" | "TSN" ) , unsigned_int )

                        | ( [ "CHUNK" ] , ( "DATA" | "INIT" | "INIT_ACK" | "SACK" | "HEARTBEAT"

                                          | "HEARTBEAT_ACK" | "ABORT" | "SHUTDOWN" | "COOKIE_ECHO" | "COOKIE_ACK" ) ) ;



snmp_protocol_field     = "TRAP" | "INFORM" | "GET" | "GETNEXT" | "GETBULK" | "SET" | "RESPONSE"

                        | ( ( "COMMUNITY" | "ENGINEID" | "CONTEXTNAME" ) , string_literal )

                        | ( ( "OID" | "ENTERPRISE" ) , oid_literal )

                        | ( "AGENTIP" , ip_address ) | ( "USER" , str_or_ident )

                        | ( ( "SYSUPTIME" | "REQID" | "NONREPEATERS" | "MAXREPETITIONS"

                            | "GENTRAP" | "SPECTRAP" | "ENGINEBOOTS" | "ENGINETIME" ) , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "AUTH" , ( "MD5" | "SHA" | "SHA256" | "SHA384" | "SHA512" ) , string_literal )

                        | ( "PRIV" , ( "DES" | "AES" ) , string_literal )

                        | ( "VARBIND" , oid_literal , varbind_type_val ) ;



varbind_type_val        = "NULLVAL" | "NULL" | ( "STRING" , string_literal ) | ( "INT" , signed_int )

                        | ( ( "TIMETICKS" | "COUNTER32" | "GAUGE32" | "COUNTER64" ) , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "IPVAL" , ip_address ) | ( "OIDVAL" , oid_literal ) ;



l7_protocol_field       = "DISCOVER" | "SOLICIT" | "OFFER" | "ADVERTISE" | "RELEASE"

                        | "SYNC" | "DELAY_REQ" | "FOLLOW_UP" | "DELAY_RESP" | "ANNOUNCE"

                        | "ACCESS_REQUEST" | "ACCESS_ACCEPT" | "ACCESS_REJECT" | "ACCESS_CHALLENGE"

                        | "ACCOUNTING_REQUEST" | "ACCOUNTING_RESPONSE" | "AUTHEN" | "AUTHOR" | "ACCT"

                        | "RRQ" | "WRQ" | "KEXINIT" | "NEWKEYS"

                        | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE" | "HEAD" | "OPTIONS" | "PATCH"

                        | "PREFACE" | "SETTINGS" | "HEADERS" | "WINDOW_UPDATE" | "PING" | "GOAWAY"

                        | "TEXT" | "BINARY" | "PONG" | "CLOSE"

                        | "CLIENT_HELLO" | "SERVER_HELLO" | "CERTIFICATE" | "FINISHED" | "APP_DATA" | "ALERT"

                        | "INITIAL" | "ZERO_RTT" | "HANDSHAKE" | "RETRY" | "SHORT"

                        | "BINDING_REQUEST" | "BINDING_RESPONSE" | "BINDING_ERROR"

                        | "INVITE" | "BYE" | "CANCEL" | "DESCRIBE" | "SETUP" | "PLAY" | "TEARDOWN"

                        | ( "EHLO" , [ string_literal ] ) | ( "HELO" , [ string_literal ] )

                        | ( "MAIL_FROM" , [ string_literal ] ) | ( "RCPT_TO" , [ string_literal ] )

                        | "QUIT" | "OK" | "ERR" | "AS_REQ" | "AS_REP" | "TGS_REQ" | "TGS_REP" | "KRB_ERROR"

                        | "BIND_REQ" | "BIND_RES" | "SEARCH_REQ" | "SEARCH_ENTRY" | "SEARCH_DONE" | "UNBIND_REQ"

                        | "NEGOTIATE" | "SESSION_SETUP" | "TREE_CONNECT" | "CREATE" | "TREE_DISCONNECT"

                        | "COMPOUND" | "GREETING" | "LOGIN" | "EOF" | "STARTUP" | "READY_FOR_QUERY"

                        | "COMMAND_COMPLETE" | "ERROR_RESPONSE" | "AUTH_OK"

                        | "CONNECT" | "CONNACK" | "PUBLISH" | "PUBACK" | "SUBSCRIBE" | "SUBACK"

                        | "PINGREQ" | "PINGRESP" | "DISCONNECT" | ( "RETAIN" , [ unsigned_int ] )

                        | "CON" | "NON" | "CHANGED" | "CREATED" | "NOT_FOUND"

                        | "PROTOCOL_HEADER" | "CONNECTION_START" | "CHANNEL_OPEN" | "BASIC_PUBLISH" | "BASIC_DELIVER"

                        | "MSEARCH" | "NOTIFY"

                        | "READ_COILS" | "READ_DISCRETE_INPUTS" | "READ_HOLDING_REGISTERS"

                        | "READ_INPUT_REGISTERS" | "WRITE_SINGLE_COIL" | "WRITE_SINGLE_REGISTER"

                        | "WRITE_MULTIPLE_REGISTERS" | "IS_RESPONSE"

                        | "WHO_IS" | "I_AM" | "READ_PROPERTY" | "WRITE_PROPERTY"

                        | "CONFIRM" | "SELECT" | "OPERATE" | "DIRECT_OPERATE" | "UNSOLICITED_RESPONSE"

                        | "SETUP_COMM" | "READ_VAR" | "WRITE_VAR" | "PLC_CONTROL"

                        | "LIST_SERVICES" | "LIST_IDENTITY" | "LIST_INTERFACES" | "REGISTER_SESSION"

                        | "UNREGISTER_SESSION" | "SEND_RR_DATA" | "SEND_UNIT_DATA"

                        | ( "HEADER" , str_or_ident , str_or_ident )

                        | ( "XOR_MAPPED_ADDR" , ip_address , [ unsigned_int ] )

                        | ( ( "CIADDR" | "YIADDR" | "SIADDR" | "DNS_SERVER" | "ROUTER" | "SUBNET_MASK"

                            | "NAS_IP" | "FRAMED_IP" | "SRCIP" | "DSTIP" | "AGENT_IP" ) , ip_address )

                        | ( "CHADDR" , mac_address )

                        | ( ( "WILL" | "WONT" | "DO" | "DONT" ) , [ "OPTION" ] , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "PRECISION" , signed_int )

                        | ( ( "TXID" | "RCODE" | "ANS_TTL" | "LEASE_TIME" | "LI" | "VN" | "STRATUM" | "POLL"

                            | "TX_TIMESTAMP" | "SEQ_ID" | "SERVICE_TYPE" | "SESSION_ID" | "FACILITY"

                            | "SEVERITY" | "PRI" | "PROTO" | "PACKETS" | "OCTETS" | "DOMAIN_ID"

                            | "SUB_AGENT_ID" | "UPTIME" | "SAMPLES" | "BLOCK" | "ERRCODE" | "MSG_CODE"

                            | "OPTION" | "STREAM_ID" | "GRPC_STATUS" | "FIN_BIT" | "MASK_KEY"

                            | "RECORD_VERSION" | "HANDSHAKE_VERSION" | "CIPHERSUITE" | "PKT_NUM" | "CSEQ"

                            | "PT" | "TIMESTAMP" | "SSRC" | "MARKER" | "ETYPE" | "RESULT_CODE" | "TREE_ID"

                            | "VERS" | "EXPTIME" | "OPAQUE" | "CAS" | "QOS" | "PKT_ID" | "RETURN_CODE"

                            | "CONTENT_FORMAT" | "CHANNEL" | "MX" | "PROTO_ID" | "UNITID" | "ADDR"

                            | "COUNT" | "INVOKE_ID" | "OBJECT_TYPE" | "OBJECT_INSTANCE" | "PROPERTY_ID"

                            | "VARIATION" | "CRC" | "SRC" | "DST" | "PDU_REF" | "DB_NUM" | "OFFSET"

                            | "SESSION_HANDLE" | "CONTEXT" | "CIP_SERVICE" | "CIP_CLASS" | "CIP_INSTANCE"

                            | "CIP_ATTR" | "SECURE_CHANNEL_ID" | "TOKEN_ID" | "SEQ_NUM" ) , unsigned_int )

                        | ( ( "QNAME" | "QTYPE" | "RDATA" | "HOSTNAME" | "MODE" | "REFID" | "MSG_TYPE"

                            | "DOMAIN" | "CLOCK_ID" | "DATA" | "APP" | "PROCID" | "MSG" | "FILENAME"

                            | "ERRMSG" | "CMD" | "ARG" | "BANNER" | "COOKIE" | "URI" | "HOST_HDR"

                            | "USER_AGENT" | "CONTENT_TYPE" | "STATUS" | "REASON" | "BODY" | "SERVICE"

                            | "METHOD" | "OPCODE" | "SNI" | "ALPN" | "DCID" | "SCID" | "TOKEN"

                            | "SOFTWARE" | "FROM" | "TO" | "CALL_ID" | "VIA" | "CONTACT" | "TRANSPORT_HDR"

                            | "SESSION" | "PARAM" | "REALM" | "CNAME" | "SNAME" | "BASE_DN" | "FILTER"

                            | "COMMAND" | "SHARE" | "PROC" | "PATH" | "ARGS" | "REPLY_TYPE" | "KEY"

                            | "VALUE" | "SQL" | "SERVER_VERSION" | "DB" | "CLIENT_ID" | "TOPIC"

                            | "URI_PATH" | "EXCHANGE" | "ROUTING_KEY" | "MAN" | "ST" | "NT" | "NTS"

                            | "USN" | "LOCATION" | "REGISTRAR" | "FUNC" | "ROSCTR" | "AREA"

                            | "CHUNK_TYPE" | "ENDPOINT_URL" | "NODE_ID" ) , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) ) ;



str_or_ident            = string_literal | identifier ;

identifier              = ( letter | "_" ) , { letter | digit | "_" } ;

unsigned_int            = ( digit , { digit } ) | ( ( "0x" | "0X" ) , hex_digit , { hex_digit } ) ;

signed_int              = ( [ "-" ] , digit , { digit } ) | unsigned_int ;

string_literal          = '"' , { string_char | escape_sequence } , '"' ;

hex_string_literal      = '"' , { hex_digit | ":" | " " } , '"' ;

mac_address             = ( hex_byte , 5 * ( ":" , hex_byte ) )

                        | ( hex_byte , 5 * ( "-" , hex_byte ) )

                        | ( hex_word , "." , hex_word , "." , hex_word ) ;

ip_address              = ipv4_address | ipv6_address ;

oid_literal             = ( [ "." ] , digit , { digit } , { "." , digit , { digit } } ) | string_literal ;

```



---



## 14. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) End-to-End Multi-Layer Production Reference Topologies



### 14.1 EVPN-VXLAN Leaf-Spine Data Center Fabric (`LLDP` + `BFD` + `BGP` + `VXLAN` + `IPFIX`)



```frameassembly

host spine_01  { ip 10.255.0.1    mac 00:1c:73:00:00:01 }

host leaf_01   { ip 10.255.0.11   mac 00:1c:73:00:01:01 }

host leaf_02   { ip 10.255.0.12   mac 00:1c:73:00:01:02 }

host collector { ip 10.255.100.50 mac 00:1c:73:00:99:50 }



flow underlay_bringup(spine, leaf) {

    spine -> leaf lldp chassis_id "00:1c:73:00:00:01" port_id "Ethernet1/1" ttl 120 sysname "spine-01" sysdesc "Arista EOS 4.32"

    spine <- leaf lldp chassis_id "00:1c:73:00:01:01" port_id "Ethernet49/1" ttl 120 sysname "leaf-01" sysdesc "Arista EOS 4.32" wait 2ms

    spine <- leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 bfd state 3 my_disc 101 your_disc 1 min_tx 50000 min_rx 50000 mult 3 wait 2ms

    spine -> leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 bfd state 3 my_disc 1 your_disc 101 min_tx 50000 min_rx 50000 mult 3 wait 2ms

    spine <- leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 tcp syn srcport 51179 dstport 179 wait 1ms

    spine -> leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 tcp syn ack wait 1ms

    spine <- leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 tcp ack wait 1ms

    spine <- leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 bgp open asn 65101 holdtime 90 bgpid 10.255.0.11 wait 2ms

    spine -> leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 bgp open asn 65000 holdtime 90 bgpid 10.255.0.1 wait 2ms

    spine <- leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 bgp keepalive wait 1ms

    spine <- leaf ttl 255 dscp 48 bgp update asn 65101 prefix "10.254.1.11/32" nexthop 10.255.0.11 wait 3ms

}



flow vxlan_east_west(vtep1, vtep2) {

    vtep1 -> vtep2 df dscp 26 vxlan vni 10100 srcport 54100 wait 2ms

}



flow export_ipfix(leaf, col) {

    leaf -> col dscp 16 ipfix domain_id 100 srcip 10.255.0.11 dstip 10.255.0.12 srcport 54100 dstport 4789 proto 17 packets 4 octets 400 wait 5ms

}



compile {

    underlay_bringup(spine_01, leaf_01)

    loop 4 { vxlan_east_west(leaf_01, leaf_02) }

    export_ipfix(leaf_01, collector)

}

```



### 14.2 Campus Zero-Trust 802.1X NAC Onboarding (`EAPOL` + `RADIUS` + `DHCP` + `ARP` + `SNMP3`)



```frameassembly

host workstation { ip 10.10.50.100 mac 00:22:44:66:88:aa }

host access_sw   { ip 10.10.50.1   mac 00:11:22:33:44:01 }

host radius_srv  { ip 10.10.1.10   mac 00:11:22:33:44:10 }

host nms_srv     { ip 10.10.1.20   mac 00:11:22:33:44:20 }



flow campus_dot1x_onboarding(ws, sw, aaa, nms) {

    ws -> sw eapol version 2 type start

    ws <- sw eapol version 2 type eap_packet eap_code 1 eap_id 1 eap_method 1 wait 2ms

    ws -> sw eapol version 2 type eap_packet eap_code 2 eap_id 1 eap_method 1 identity "eng-laptop-42" wait 2ms

    sw -> aaa radius access_request id 42 user "eng-laptop-42" nas_ip 10.10.50.1 service_type 2 wait 4ms

    sw <- aaa radius access_accept id 42 user "eng-laptop-42" framed_ip 10.10.50.100 service_type 2 wait 2ms

    ws <- sw eapol version 2 type eap_packet eap_code 3 eap_id 1 wait 3ms

    ws -> sw dhcp discover xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa hostname "eng-laptop-42" wait 3ms

    ws <- sw dhcp offer xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa yiaddr 10.10.50.100 router 10.10.50.1 dns_server 10.10.1.53 subnet_mask 255.255.255.0 lease_time 43200 wait 3ms

    ws -> sw dhcp request xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa yiaddr 10.10.50.100 hostname "eng-laptop-42" wait 3ms

    ws <- sw dhcp ack xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa yiaddr 10.10.50.100 router 10.10.50.1 dns_server 10.10.1.53 subnet_mask 255.255.255.0 lease_time 43200 wait 3ms

    ws -> sw arp reply gratuitous sha 00:22:44:66:88:aa spa 10.10.50.100 tpa 10.10.50.100 wait 2ms

    sw -> nms vlan 99 snmp3 inform user "nac_auditor" engineid "80001f88801122334455" engineboots 5 enginetime 3600 auth sha256 "AuditAuthKey2026!" priv aes "AuditPrivKey2026!" reqid 500 sysuptime 360000 oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.4 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 string "access-sw-floor2" varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.8.12 int 1 wait 3ms

    sw <- nms vlan 99 snmp3 response user "nac_auditor" engineid "80001f88801122334455" engineboots 5 enginetime 3600 auth sha256 "AuditAuthKey2026!" priv aes "AuditPrivKey2026!" reqid 500 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.8.12 int 1 wait 2ms

}



compile { campus_dot1x_onboarding(workstation, access_sw, radius_srv, nms_srv) }

```



### 14.3 Dual-Stack IPv4 & IPv6 Cloud Service Mesh (`DNS` + `TCP` + `TLS` + `GRPC` + `REDIS` + `POSTGRES`)



```frameassembly

host ingress_v4 { ip 10.244.1.10 }

host coredns_v4 { ip 10.96.0.10 }

host orders_v4  { ip 10.244.2.20 }

host storage_v4 { ip 10.244.3.30 }



host ingress_v6 { ip fd00:10:244:1::10 }

host coredns_v6 { ip fd00:10:96::10 }

host orders_v6  { ip fd00:10:244:2::20 }

host storage_v6 { ip fd00:10:244:3::30 }



flow service_mesh_checkout(gw, dns_srv, svc, db) {

    gw -> dns_srv flowlabel 0x10200 dns query txid 901 qname "orders.prod.svc.cluster.local" qtype "A"

    gw <- dns_srv flowlabel 0x10200 dns response txid 901 qname "orders.prod.svc.cluster.local" qtype "A" rdata "10.244.2.20" wait 1ms

    gw -> svc tcp syn srcport 51051 dstport 50051 mss 1460 wscale 7 sack_perm wait 1ms

    gw <- svc tcp syn ack mss 1460 wscale 7 sack_perm wait 1ms

    gw -> svc tcp ack wait 1ms

    gw -> svc dstport 50051 tls client_hello sni "orders.prod.svc.cluster.local" ciphersuite 4865 alpn "h2" wait 1ms

    gw <- svc srcport 50051 tls server_hello ciphersuite 4865 alpn "h2" wait 1ms

    gw -> svc grpc service "commerce.OrderService" method "CreateOrder" payload "sku=NVME-4TB&qty=2" wait 2ms

    svc -> db redis get key "inventory:NVME-4TB" wait 1ms

    svc <- db redis reply_type "BULK" value "42" wait 1ms

    svc -> db postgres startup user "orders_app" db "commerce" wait 1ms

    svc <- db postgres auth_ok ready_for_query wait 1ms

    svc -> db postgres query sql "INSERT INTO orders (sku, qty) VALUES ('NVME-4TB', 2);" wait 2ms

    svc <- db postgres command_complete ready_for_query wait 1ms

    gw <- svc grpc service "commerce.OrderService" method "CreateOrder" grpc_status 0 payload "order_id=90042" wait 2ms

}



compile {

    service_mesh_checkout(ingress_v4, coredns_v4, orders_v4, storage_v4)

    service_mesh_checkout(ingress_v6, coredns_v6, orders_v6, storage_v6)

}

```



### 14.4 Carrier WAN Failover (`VRRP` + `BFD` + `OSPF` + `QINQ` + `IKEV2` + `MPLS` + `ESP` + `WIREGUARD`)



```frameassembly

host branch_r1 { ip 10.250.10.2  mac 00:00:5e:00:01:0a }

host branch_r2 { ip 10.250.10.3  mac 00:1e:be:25:10:03 }

host hq_hub    { ip 172.31.250.1 mac 00:1e:be:31:fa:01 }



flow wan_failover_and_vpn(r1, r2, hub) {

    r1 -> r2 ttl 255 dscp 48 vrrp vrid 10 priority 200 adv_int 100 vip 10.250.10.1 version 3

    r1 -> r2 ttl 255 dscp 48 bfd state 1 diag 1 my_disc 501 your_disc 502 min_tx 100000 min_rx 100000 mult 3 wait 2ms

    r2 -> r1 ttl 255 dscp 48 vrrp vrid 10 priority 220 adv_int 100 vip 10.250.10.1 version 3 wait 2ms

    r1 -> r2 ttl 1 dscp 48 ospf hello router_id 10.250.0.1 area_id 0.0.0.0 hello_interval 10 dead_interval 40 priority 100 wait 1ms

    r1 -> r2 ttl 1 dscp 48 ospf lsu router_id 10.250.0.1 area_id 0 wait 1ms

    r1 <- r2 ttl 1 dscp 48 ospf lsack router_id 10.250.0.2 area_id 0 wait 2ms

    r2 -> hub qinq 2100 inner_vlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 sa_init initiator_spi 0x1122334455667788 responder_spi 0 msgid 0 flags 0x08 next_payload 33 wait 2ms

    r2 <- hub qinq 2100 inner_vlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 sa_init initiator_spi 0x1122334455667788 responder_spi 0x99aabbccddeeff00 msgid 0 flags 0x20 next_payload 33 wait 2ms

    r2 -> hub qinq 2100 inner_vlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 create_child_sa initiator_spi 0x1122334455667788 responder_spi 0x99aabbccddeeff00 msgid 1 flags 0x08 next_payload 46 wait 2ms

    r2 -> hub mpls 32100 exp 5 bos 1 mpls_ttl 60 dscp 46 esp spi 0x00102030 seq 1 iv "1122334455667788" icv "aabbccddeeff001122334455" next_header 4 payload "BRANCH_VOICE_FRAME" wait 2ms

    r2 -> hub dscp 46 wireguard type data receiver 0x50607080 counter 1 payload "WG_BACKUP_TUNNEL" wait 2ms

}



compile { wan_failover_and_vpn(branch_r1, branch_r2, hq_hub) }

```



### 14.5 5G Core N2 `SCTP` (`NGAP` `PPID 60`) & Service-Based Architecture `HTTP2`



```frameassembly

host gnodeb { ip 10.50.12.10 mac 00:25:90:50:12:10 }

host amf    { ip 10.50.12.1  mac 00:25:90:50:12:01 }

host ausf   { ip 10.50.20.1  mac 00:25:90:50:20:01 }



flow fiveg_n2_and_sba(gnb, amf_nf, ausf_nf) {

    gnb -> amf_nf dscp 48 sctp srcport 38412 dstport 38412 init vtag 0 tsn 1000

    gnb <- amf_nf dscp 48 sctp init_ack vtag 305419896 tsn 2000 wait 1ms

    gnb -> amf_nf dscp 48 sctp cookie_echo vtag 305419896 wait 1ms

    gnb <- amf_nf dscp 48 sctp cookie_ack vtag 305419896 wait 1ms

    gnb -> amf_nf dscp 48 sctp data vtag 305419896 tsn 1000 stream 1 ssn 0 ppid 60 hexpayload "000f401800000200550002000100" wait 2ms

    gnb <- amf_nf dscp 48 sctp sack vtag 305419896 tsn 1000 wait 1ms

    amf_nf -> ausf_nf dscp 34 http2 preface wait 1ms

    amf_nf -> ausf_nf dscp 34 http2 headers stream_id 1 payload "POST /nausf-auth/v1/ue-authentications" wait 1ms

    amf_nf <- ausf_nf dscp 34 http2 data stream_id 1 payload "{\"authType\":\"5G_AKA\"}" wait 2ms

}



compile { fiveg_n2_and_sba(gnodeb, amf, ausf) }

```



### 14.6 IEC 62443 Purdue Industrial Conduit (`MODBUS` + `DNP3` + `S7COMM` + `BACNET` + `ETHERNETIP` + `OPCUA` + `SYSLOG`)



```frameassembly

host scada_hmi      { ip 172.22.10.5   mac 00:1b:21:22:0a:05 }

host field_plc      { ip 172.22.10.50  mac 00:0e:8c:22:0a:32 }

host idmz_historian { ip 172.22.20.100 mac 00:50:56:22:14:64 }



flow purdue_ot_conduit(hmi, plc, idmz) {

    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 modbus read_holding_registers txid 1 unitid 1 addr 40001 count 4

    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 6 modbus read_holding_registers txid 1 unitid 1 count 4 value 13800 is_response wait 2ms

    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 dnp3 read src 1 dst 10 group 60 variation 1 wait 2ms

    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 6 dnp3 func "RESPONSE" src 10 dst 1 group 30 variation 1 wait 2ms

    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 s7comm rosctr "JOB" read_var pdu_ref 10 area "DB" db_num 1 offset 0 count 4 wait 2ms

    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 6 s7comm rosctr "ACK_DATA" read_var pdu_ref 10 count 4 payload "DB1_OK" wait 2ms

    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 5 bacnet read_property invoke_id 5 object_type 0 object_instance 1 property_id 85 wait 2ms

    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 ethernetip send_rr_data session_handle 0x1001 cip_service 0x0e cip_class 0x04 cip_instance 100 cip_attr 3 wait 2ms

    hmi -> idmz vlan 120 pcp 4 opcua msg_type "HEL" chunk_type "F" endpoint_url "opc.tcp://172.22.20.100:4840" wait 1ms

    hmi <- idmz vlan 120 pcp 4 opcua msg_type "ACK" chunk_type "F" wait 1ms

    hmi -> idmz vlan 120 pcp 4 opcua msg_type "MSG" chunk_type "F" secure_channel_id 10 token_id 1 seq_num 1 reqid 1 node_id "ns=3;s=Feeder01.KV" payload "138.0" wait 2ms

    hmi -> idmz vlan 120 pcp 4 transport tcp syslog facility 4 severity 5 hostname "scada-hmi-01" app "poller" msg "IEC62443 poll cycle complete" wait 2ms

}



compile { purdue_ot_conduit(scada_hmi, field_plc, idmz_historian) }

```



---



## 15. FrameAssembly (`.fasm`) Pre-Output Verification Checklist for AI Models



Before returning any `.fasm` snippet or Rust integration code, verify all 12 invariants:



1. **Three-Block Completeness**: Does the file contain `host <id> { ip <addr> ... }`, `flow <id>(<params>) { ... }`, and **exactly one** `compile { ... }` block?

2. **Comment & Quote Hygiene**: Are all comments prefixed with `//` (never `#`, `;`, or `/* */`) and all string literals enclosed in double quotes `"..."` (never `'...'`)? Are internal training headers (`// PROMPT:`, `// TOKENS:`, `// INSTRUCTION:`) omitted from user-facing `.fasm` code?

3. **No Punctuation Separators**: Are keywords and values separated purely by whitespace (zero `=`, `:`, or trailing `;`, and no CIDR `/24` masks inside `host`)?

4. **Canonical Keyword Names**: Did you write `ip` (not `ipv4`/`ipv6`), `srcport`/`dstport` (not `sport`/`dport`), `acknum <n>` (not `ack <n>`), `ttl` (not `hop_limit`), `host_hdr` (not `host` in HTTP/SSDP), `transport_hdr` (not `transport` in RTSP), `xid` (not `txid` in DHCP/OpenFlow/NFS), and `reqid` (not `req_id`)?

5. **Inline `wait` Suffix**: Is every delay attached inline to a packet statement (`wait 5ms` using `ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, or `m`), never on a standalone `wait` line or `[+5ms]` prefix?

6. **Dual-Stack Endpoint Homogeneity**: Do both endpoints on every `a -> b` or `a <- b` statement belong to the same IP family (both IPv4 or both IPv6)?

7. **Numeric Range Gates**: Are `vlan`/`qinq`/`inner_vlan` within `1..=4094`, `dscp` within `0..=63`, `ecn` within `0..=3`, `ttl` within `0..=255`, `flowlabel` within `0..=1048575`, and `gentrap` within `0..=6`?

8. **Protocol Exclusivity**: Are TCP flags/options omitted from `udp` and `snmp1`/`2`/`3` statements? Are `getbulk`, `inform`, and `counter64` omitted from `snmp1`? Does `snmp3` `priv` always include an accompanying `auth <alg> "<pass>"` with unquoted algorithm tokens?

9. **Quoted vs Unquoted Prefix/ID Rules**: Is `bgp` `prefix` a quoted CIDR string (`prefix "10.0.0.0/8"`), whereas `rip` `prefix` is a bare IP (`prefix 10.0.0.0`)? Are `stp` `root_id`/`bridge_id` quoted strings (`"4096/00:1c:73:00:00:01"`)?

10. **IKEv2 & Modbus/DNP3 Response Keywords**: Does `ikev2` use `sa_init`, `create_child_sa`, or `informational` (never `exchange auth`)? Does `modbus` use `is_response` and `dnp3` use `func "RESPONSE"` for replies?

11. **Single Modifier Instance per Statement**: Except for repeatable `varbind`, `header`, `args`, and distinct TCP/L7 flags, does each modifier keyword appear at most once per statement, with either `payload` or `hexpayload` (never both)?

12. **Verified Rust API Types**: When generating Rust code against `frameassembly`, does `lex` expect `Vec<(Token<'a>, Range<usize>)>`, `compile_program` expect `Result<Vec<(Vec<u8>, u64)>, String>`, and `CompilerError` match `(usize, usize)` spans and tuple `BackendError(String)`?
